email.verify_email.subject: Confirm your email for ${app}
email.verify_email.intro: Thanks for creating a ${app} account. Please confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
email.reset_password.subject: Reset your ${app} password
email.reset_password.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your ${app} account.
email.reset_password.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour and can only be used once.
email.reset_password.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password will not change.
email.password_changed.subject: Your ${app} password was changed
email.password_changed.body: The password for your ${app} account was just changed.
email.password_changed.not_you: If you did not make this change, reset your password right away and contact support.
email.mfa_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on
email.mfa_enabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your ${app} account. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.
email.mfa_enabled.not_you: If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.
email.mfa_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off
email.mfa_disabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your ${app} account.
email.mfa_disabled.not_you: If you did not make this change, reset your password right away and contact support.
email.staff_invite.subject: You have been invited to ${app} administration
email.staff_invite.intro: A staff account was created for you on ${app}. Choose a password to activate it. You will then be asked to set up two-factor authentication.
email.staff_invite.expiry: This link expires in 72 hours. Ask an administrator for a new invitation if it has expired.
email.account_closed.subject: Your ${app} account has been closed
email.account_closed.body: Your ${app} account has been closed and your personal information is being removed. Records we must keep by law (such as receipts) are retained as described in our privacy policy.
